remarks: This fully renovated townhome is a must-see! Enjoy this band new white kitchen fully equipped with a stove, built-in microwave, fridge, and dishwasher. Opposite the kitchen is a perfectly sized dining nook, and half bathroom. Turn into the living room with refinished hardwood floors and a coat closet. The second floor offers two generously sized bedrooms, with 2 large closets in both rooms. The second floor also has a renovated full bathroom and hall closet. But the true gem of this home is the full private basement with private laundry. Use this space however your life needs. Gym, office, playroom, use your imagination! Assigned off-street parking spots are included in the rent. Pets are welcome for an additional $50 fee at the landlord's discretion. Easy commuting with near by entrance for I-95 and Route 7 and Merritt Parkway just a few miles down the road. Easy to show, come pay a visit today!
